hints.title: Initial Subsequence Tally
hints.text: Count how many pattern subsequences already exist in text by tracking occurrences of pattern[0] as you iterate.

hints.title: Inserting Added Character
hints.text: Adding pattern[0] at index 0 pairs with all occurrences of pattern[1] in text. Adding pattern[1] at the very end pairs with all occurrences of pattern[0].

hints.title: Greedy Additional Contribution
hints.text: The best additional contribution is max(count(pattern[1]), count(pattern[0])).

hints.title: Linear Pass Subsequence Counter

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulates matching prefix pairs and character counts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Inserting at all possible positions and re-counting subsequences results in O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes extreme placements (start vs end) and counts pairs in O(n).
